title: Lilies and Chains
description: A surreal scene featuring a blonde woman in a blue corset seated at a table with a pink bowl of white lilies and sliced oranges. She is chained by a golden chain to a demonic blue hand emerging from a swirling vortex above, while a green-skinned woman with white lilies in her hair emerges from a scroll-like form beside her, holding a colorful handbag.
prompt: A surreal gothic painting of a beautiful blonde woman wearing a blue corset and black choker, seated at a table covered with a red cloth. She has white lilies and green leaves in her hair. A demonic blue hand with horns emerges from a swirling vortex in the top left, holding a thick golden chain attached to her neck. Beside her, a green-skinned woman's face with white lilies in her hair emerges from a decorative scroll. On the table are sliced oranges, a pink bowl of lilies, and scattered tarot cards. She holds a vibrant yellow and red handbag. Dark conservatory background with starry twilight sky visible through glass ceiling.
